bagPolicy.summary: Bags are allowed in the concert area, but large backpacks and large bags should be left at home or in the cloakroom. No size limit is published.
allowed: Empty transparent water bottle up to 0.5 litres
prohibited: Large backpacks and large bags (cloakroom recommended)
Firearms, knives and other bladed weapons
DSLR or interchangeable-lens cameras, video cameras and drones
Selfie sticks, audio recorders, tablets and laptops
Camping furniture such as stools, tables or grills
Large flags or banners over about 30 x 40 cm
bagPolicy.note: A security check is carried out on arrival. The cloakroom costs 4 euros and accepts card payments only.

parking.note: There is no customer parking at Allas Pool. Visitors arriving by car should check the City of Helsinki website for nearby parking spaces, prices, and payment methods. Boaters can park at nearby marinas such as Katajanokka Helsinki Marina, Viroallas, or Linnanallas.

rideshare.note: Allas Live doesn't publish a rideshare zone. An accessible taxi can stop near the Allas Live area; for other rides, use the pickup point your app suggests.

concessions.note: Allas Restaurants offers a variety of dining experiences with Seagrill providing casual dining and a cocktail bar, Allas Cafe & Terrace serving breakfast, lunch, and coffee, and Sky Bar offering a unique meeting place with views. Special offerings include a porridge bar and self-service dining at Seagrill.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Allas Live is accessible, with wooden decked paths, though much of the ground is sand and grass. There is a dedicated wheelchair area, an accessible viewing platform, and an accessible toilet nearby. Use the main entrance for accessible entry.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Allas Live's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Allas Live uses Ticketmaster mobile tickets. Have your ticket ready on your phone at the entrance.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance is at the main doors of Allas Pool. The Finnair Fast Track entrance is beside it, and the OP Early Entry entrance is to the left, at the end of the building. Tickets are checked at the entrance, and concerts are 18+ unless stated.
